title: A tetranuclear samarium(II) inverse sandwich from direct reduction of toluene by a samarium(II) siloxide

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (Schlenk or glovebox), KC8 (2.9 mg, 0.021 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) was added to [SmL3]2 (L = OSi(OtBu)3; 20 mg, 0.011 mmol, 0.5 equiv.) in toluene (5 mL) at -40 °C and the mixture was stirred at -40 °C for two days. Graphite and some crystalline material were removed by filtration. The red-pink solution was concentrated to 0.5 mL and stored overnight at -40 °C, affording crystals of 1 together with 2. Complexes 1 and 2 could not be isolated analytically pure in useful amounts. The same reduction in the presence of 2.2.2-cryptand also gave a mixture.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert-atmosphere Schlenk line or argon glovebox; filtration; low-temperature crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Graphite and some crystals were filtered off; the filtrate was concentrated to 0.5 mL and stored overnight at -40 °C to give crystals of 1 and 2.

source_locations.location: discussion of reduction of [SmL3]2 with KC8

synthesis.procedure: Prepared in the same KC8 reduction of [SmL3]2 in toluene at -40 °C used for 1. After two days, filtration, concentration to 0.5 mL and overnight storage at -40 °C gave crystals of 1 and 2. A few crystals of 2 were separated by warming the mixture to room temperature and washing with cold toluene to remove 1. Complex 2 is stable in the mother liquor at -40 °C for several days but decomposes over two days at room temperature.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert-atmosphere Schlenk line or argon glovebox
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, concentration to 0.5 mL, overnight storage at -40 °C; a few crystals of 2 were isolated by warming and washing with cold toluene.

properties.summary: The UV-Vis-NIR spectrum of 2 in toluene shows broad, intense visible bands assigned to f–d and/or charge-transfer transitions typical of samarium(II). No magnetic data are reported.

measurements.name: UV-Vis-NIR absorption
measurements.conditions: 0.1 mM in toluene; visible bands described as broad and intense; instrument spikes deleted near 1730–1654 nm and 870–824 nm

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, a cold (-40 °C) solution of HOSi(OtBu)3 (HL; 403 mg, 1.52 mmol) in dme (2.5 mL) was added to [Sm(HMDS)2(thf)2] (469 mg, 0.762 mmol) in dme (2.5 mL). The dark brown solution was stirred overnight at -40 °C, concentrated to about 2.5 mL, and stored at -40 °C to give large dark crystals (183 mg). Further concentration of the supernatant and storage at -40 °C gave additional product (combined yield 426 mg, 77%).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert-atmosphere Schlenk line or argon glovebox; protonolysis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent reduced to about 2.5 mL and the solution stored at -40 °C; a second crop was obtained after further concentration.

properties.summary: A UV-Vis-NIR spectrum of 3 in toluene is shown in the supporting information (2 mM); the main text does not report peak positions, and no magnetic data are given.

measurements.conditions: 2 mM in toluene; Figure S21, no numerical band maxima stated

synthesis.procedure: Complex 3 (100 mg, 0.069 mmol; about 70 mM) was dissolved in toluene (1 mL). Storage at room temperature for three days and then at -40 °C overnight deposited dark brown crystals of 4 (23 mg, 44%). The co-product is [SmL3]2. The reaction was also followed by 1H NMR in toluene-d8.
synthesis.time: three days at room temperature and one night at -40 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert atmosphere; standing solution, no added alkali-metal reductant
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark brown crystals deposited directly from the concentrated toluene solution and were collected; the evaporated residue contained [SmL3]2 (about 44% by NMR) and unreacted 3 (about 50%).

properties.summary: The UV-Vis-NIR spectrum of 4 in toluene shows broad, intense visible bands consistent with f–d and/or charge-transfer transitions of samarium(II). No magnetic measurements are reported.
